DARKROOM WORKSHOPS

Hi people! This is gonna be a newsletter with info about my photography darkroom workshops!

In Dutch, the darkroom is called the doka, short for donkere kamer, which means… dark room.

Welcome to Daniel’s Doka!

THE BASIC PREMISE

  • A 3-hour workshop in my apartment, where I convert the living room into the doka
  • 2 students at a time — bring a friend, or meet a fellow student!
  • Chemicals and photo paper provided

WORKSHOP OPTIONS

Option A

I don’t have film negatives

  • Get a camera and film, shoot black & white pics, and come to the workshop with a fully shot roll, undeveloped
  • Develop the film
  • Print a contact sheet

Option B

I have film negatives, or I want to print your photos

  • We just learn to print photos — the most fun and artful part of the process

Option C

I want to do everything

  • Combine A and B in two workshops, on two separate nights

Option D

I want to do a photo walk too

  • Option C, with a photo walk together first

DO YOU ALREADY HAVE FILM NEGATIVES?

If you are some kind of weirdo like me that already possesses developed film negatives, let me know!!! We can do a workshop much sooner. We would skip to the photo printing, the most artful and fun part.

Tip: for those of you visiting parents any time soon, ask them if they have old negatives!!!!

Otherwise you could also choose one of mine that you like.

DO YOU NOT HAVE FILM NEGATIVES?

The other type of workshop covers the full process, starting with developing film negatives and printing a contact sheet. This takes more planning. It would go like this:

  • You get a 35mm film camera
    • I can lend you one of my cheap ones, or you can shop on Vinted or at flea markets (try to make sure it’s tested), or at a camera shop if you want a nice, fully tested one
    • Ask me for free camera advice if you want to buy one
  • You get some black & white film — I recommend Ilford FP4+
  • Shoot 36 photos (or 24 if you got a smaller roll)
  • We could do some of that on a photo walk together, perhaps

DETAILS TO IRON OUT

  • Price. A one-day workshop like this in Amsterdam at a professional place like doka107 would be €90. This would be significantly less, and a lot more chill and fun :)
  • Booking system. I’ll let you know when it’s ready.
  • Drying photos and film.
    • I might not be able to dry them in time for you to take home with you.
    • I’m looking for equipment to help with that. Until then, we could meet up or you could pick them up later.

Stay tuned for more!
